# technitium_settings_optional_protocols (Resource)

Manages the optional DNS protocols: DNS-over-UDP/TCP PROXY, DNS-over-HTTP, DNS-over-TLS, DNS-over-HTTPS and DNS-over-QUIC (the Optional Protocols tab of the Settings page).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dns_over_http_port` (Number) The TCP port for DNS-over-HTTP. Technitium's default is `80`.
- `dns_over_http_real_ip_header` (String) The HTTP header that holds the client's IP address on DNS-over-HTTP requests from a reverse proxy.
- `dns_over_http_unix_socket` (String) The path of the Unix domain socket for `enable_dns_over_http_unix_socket`. The server needs write access to its directory.
- `dns_over_https_port` (Number) The TCP port for DNS-over-HTTPS. Technitium's default is `443`.
- `dns_over_https_unix_socket` (String) The path of the Unix domain socket for `enable_dns_over_https_unix_socket`. The server needs write access to its directory.
- `dns_over_quic_port` (Number) The UDP port for DNS-over-QUIC. Technitium's default is `853`.
- `dns_over_tcp_proxy_port` (Number) The TCP port for DNS-over-TCP-PROXY. Technitium's default is `538`.
- `dns_over_tls_port` (Number) The TCP port for DNS-over-TLS. Technitium's default is `853`.
- `dns_over_udp_proxy_port` (Number) The UDP port for DNS-over-UDP-PROXY. Technitium's default is `538`.
- `dns_reverse_proxy_network_acl` (List of String) The reverse proxies allowed to send DNS-over-UDP-PROXY, DNS-over-TCP-PROXY and DNS-over-HTTP requests. Each entry is an IP address or network; prefix it with `!` to deny it. Entries are checked in order, and anything unmatched is denied.
- `dns_tls_certificate_password` (String, Sensitive) The password of `dns_tls_certificate_path`, if any.
- `dns_tls_certificate_path` (String) The path on the server of the PKCS #12 (.pfx) certificate, with its private key, for DNS-over-TLS and DNS-over-HTTPS.
- `enable_dns_over_http` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-HTTP requests, for use behind a TLS terminating reverse proxy such as nginx. Allow only your reverse proxy in `dns_reverse_proxy_network_acl`. Also enables certificate renewal with the HTTP challenge for DNS-over-HTTPS.
- `enable_dns_over_http3` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-HTTPS requests over HTTP/3 as well. Needs `enable_dns_over_https`.
- `enable_dns_over_http_help_redirect` (Boolean) Redirect browsers that open the `/dns-query` path to the DNS-over-HTTP(S) help page at `/`.
- `enable_dns_over_http_unix_socket` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-HTTP requests on a Unix domain socket.
- `enable_dns_over_https` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-HTTPS requests.
- `enable_dns_over_https_unix_socket` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-HTTPS requests on a Unix domain socket.
- `enable_dns_over_quic` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-QUIC requests.
- `enable_dns_over_tcp_proxy` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-TCP-PROXY requests ([PROXY protocol](https://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) version 1 and 2). Allow only your reverse proxy in `dns_reverse_proxy_network_acl`.
- `enable_dns_over_tls` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-TLS requests.
- `enable_dns_over_udp_proxy` (Boolean) Accept DNS-over-UDP-PROXY requests ([PROXY protocol](https://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt) version 1 and 2). Allow only your reverse proxy in `dns_reverse_proxy_network_acl`.
- `enable_edns_client_subnet_source_address` (Boolean) Take the client's IP address from the EDNS Client Subnet option of DNS-over-UDP and DNS-over-TCP requests, so a DNS proxy can pass it on. The proxy must be allowed in `dns_reverse_proxy_network_acl`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.
